isaSafety.title: ISA Safety Companion
isaSafety.subtitle: Highline safety reference
isaSafety.disclaimer: Based on ISA:21 (2023) and related standards. This app provides recommendations, the final decision is always yours. For definitive texts open the official ISA:21 PDF.

isa21Limits.title: ISA:21 Force Limits
isa21Limits.summary: Key safety limits for highline systems

serene.title: SERENE
serene.strongDetail: Anchor holds min 2× expected peak load. Target: 48 kN primary, 24 kN secondary.
serene.equalizedDetail: Load evenly distributed across all points. Sliding-X actively, BFK statically.
serene.redundantDetail: If 1 point fails, rest holds the load. Min 2 independent attachment points.
serene.efficientDetail: Angles between legs < 60° ideal, < 90° maximum. Above 120° = catastrophic.
serene.noExtensionDetail: If 1 leg fails, masterpoint stays in place → no shock load. Backup / limiting knots.

snareSane.title: SNARE SANE
snareSane.strengthDetail: Anchor holds min 2× expected peak load. Calculate max load (peak fall × safety factor 2).
snareSane.noAbrasionDetail: No sharp edges in load path. Visual check, padding at sharp edges.
snareSane.redundancyDetail: If 1 component fails, anchor still holds. Min 2 independent points.
snareSane.equalizationDetail: Load evenly distributed. Sliding-X actively, BFK statically.
snareSane.smallAnglesDetail: Angle between anchor legs < 60° ideal. 90° = per-leg 71%, 120° = 100%, > 120° = catastrophic.
snareSane.noExtensionDetail: Failure of one leg must not cause shock load. Backup / limiting knots.

nylonRule.title: Sub-40m Nylon Rule
nylonRule.summary: Webbing material compatibility with line length
nylonRule.hint: Sub-40m highline = mainline + backup + leash all PA (nylon). Static materials (PES, UHMWPE) generate 2-3× higher peak forces = risk of exceeding ISA:21 limit 12 kN.

wind.title: Wind Advisory
wind.summary: ISA thresholds for rig / derig decision
wind.hint: Watch Ventusky, Windy or Open-Meteo. Storm approach = derig immediately (electrostatic risk).

rlt.title: Recommended Lifetime (RLT)
rlt.summary: Recommended webbing lifetime by type and material
rlt.hint: Days = exposure to environment (UV, rain), NOT from manufacture date. Storage doesn't count.

forgottenLeash.title: Forgotten Leash
forgottenLeash.summary: Most fatal recurring failure in highline
forgottenLeash.fl1Detail: Documented fatalities: Brazil 26.7.2025 (SUPER experienced guy forgot tie-in), Slovenia 2023 (permanent nerve damage). Most common cause of serious HL injuries.
forgottenLeash.fl2Detail: Experienced riggers are at highest risk. Muscle memory = 'I know what I'm doing, no check needed' → one forgotten session restart is enough.
forgottenLeash.fl3Detail: Break (water / WC / phone / rescue) → return to line WITHOUT leash. Critical transition moment.
forgottenLeash.fl4Detail: Not just first session. Before every entry onto the line = physically verify leash + PAS by hand.
forgottenLeash.fl5Detail: Say out loud 'am I tied in?' → 'yes, verified'. Requires active cognitive check, not muscle memory.

masterpoint.title: Masterpoint doctrine (ISA 2025+)
masterpoint.summary: Always consolidated masterpoint, not separated anchors
masterpoint.mp1Detail: Always consolidated masterpoint where both main and backup terminate. Nicolas Ospina 31.5.2025 (ISA Certified Rigger) cites ISA guidelines.
masterpoint.mp2Detail: Double ring / rigging plate / doubled sling. Criterion: one common point for both main and backup.
masterpoint.mp3Detail: Hidden dependency. Roberto: 'if you lose main shackle, you lose main line AND main anchor too.'
masterpoint.mp4Detail: Reduces extension on failure. Simplifies inspection (one point = clear check). Reduces rigger cognitive load.
masterpoint.mp5Detail: Old: 'main and backup should be separate.' NOT VALID in 2025+. Validates TZ post-cert learning from Ostrov 16-18.8.2026.

bfkSlidingX.title: When BFK, when Sliding-X
bfkSlidingX.summary: Decision framework for longline + wind exposure
bfkSlidingX.bsx1Detail: HL < 200-300m length. Vertically parallel points. Stable load direction (no wind-driven asymmetric load).
bfkSlidingX.bsx2Detail: HL > 200-300m (wind-driven asymmetric load can collapse BFK). Wind exposure. Non-parallel points. Weak or questionable rock.
bfkSlidingX.bsx3Detail: 'A BFK is sufficient as long as one of the ropes could get cut and the rest of the anchor remains above the 24kN MBS.' — Sascha Grill 28.2.2026.
bfkSlidingX.bsx4Detail: 'Anything greater than 200-300m, I'm going with sliding X.' — Roberto De Oliveira 1.3.2026 (800m longline failure case).

alWeblockCorrosion.title: Al weblock corrosion in perma-rig
alWeblockCorrosion.summary: Active ISA incident 2026 — casting defect crack after 1-2 years
alWeblockCorrosion.awc1Detail: ISA actively addressing (x-ray plan proposed by ISA Safety Commission). 2 documented cases: Roberto 20.3.2026 heavily used perma-rig weblock, Purelock 3-4 months.
alWeblockCorrosion.awc2Detail: Al weblock in perma-rig with humidity → casting defect crack after 1-2 years. Nothing happened, but weblock fully damaged. Early warning.
alWeblockCorrosion.awc3Detail: Perma-rig weblock ROTATE every 6 months (don't leave in one spot 1+ year). Steel weblock preferred for perma-rig in humid environment.
alWeblockCorrosion.awc4Detail: Coastal / marine sites require more aggressive re-inspection cycle. X-ray inspection recommended for suspect Al weblocks.

vortexCaveat.title: Vortex leash ring — tape gate shut!
vortexCaveat.vc1Detail: Sascha 10.7.2025: 'I stepped on the gate and it opened, I heard from a friend that they stepped on it while tandeming and even UNCLIPPED the line!'
vortexCaveat.vc2Detail: Only for tandem highlining (when you need a larger ring). ALWAYS tape gate shut (electrical tape over gate).
vortexCaveat.vc3Detail: 2× standard Slacktivity Highline Ring instead of Vortex. Adds redundancy + removes gate risk.
vortexCaveat.vc4Detail: Verify tape integrity. Never step on gate side of ring. Buddy check — second pair of eyes checks gate.
